_description: Phase 5 Tier 2 compatibility test — the ext-apps `qr-server` MCP App (Python/FastMCP). The UI contains form inputs + a generate button that fires tools/call via AppBridge backchannel to regenerate the QR code. THIS IS THE BIDIRECTIONAL TEST: typing and clicking generate inside the iframe must round-trip through AppBridge → MCP client → qr-server's generate_qr tool → back to the iframe as ui/notifications/tool-result. If this tier renders AND the QR changes on input, the full MCP Apps protocol is proven spec-compliant. Requires qr-server running on http://localhost:3002/mcp and a matching MCP server entry in Settings → MCP Servers named 'qr-server'.

components.text: Python MCP server on localhost:3002. AppHost calls generate_qr via the MCP client, then pushes the tool result (QR image) to the iframe via sendToolResult(). The iframe renders the image on receipt — proving the full tool→UI pipeline.
